parts:
For anyone who hasn't been checking the new dev forum on discourse, I just posted a draft of
a set of guidelines for Stan users who plan on developing R packages providing an interface to Stan here (scroll down to the latest reply):

http://discourse.mc-stan.org/t/guidelines-for-rstan-based-packages/83

If you have any feedback please let me know!

Jonah
